intro_call_summary: Ananya is a quantitative researcher bridging clinical psychology and computational biology. She wants a PhD where she can combine machine learning on clinical/EHR data with the molecular and neurobiological basis of trauma and stress. She is most excited about labs working on PTSD treatment-outcome prediction, computational psychiatry, and the genomics/neurobiology of stress. She is an international (Indian) applicant and needs programs/positions open to international students. She is open to reach schools but wants a realistic spread.
